warnings: B4A's section is drawn on this stair sheet (the beam-section sheet S-07 has no B4A cut). It is printed with DB bars ('2- DB 19 mm.' four times + 'ป-RB 6 mm.@0.20m.'), unlike the Ø (RB) callouts on S-07; the cut shows two bars at each top corner row and two at each bottom row, so the four labels are read as 2+2 top and 2+2 bottom.

ST1 is drawn four times (upper/lower flight x floor 1/2) with different spans and bar spacings — one element per flight with a level field (section 8 logic), never merged. Multi-layer stair reinforcement goes in bar_layers[] (section 0.6), each layer at the location its leader points to.
Floor-1 flights are DB 12 mm. @ 0.05 m. on the landing and lower flight bottom — unusually dense; taken as printed (two independent labels agree on 0.05 in each floor-1 view).

ST1 (ช่วงบน) ชั้น 2: the landing top leader is labelled 'RB 9 mm. @ 0.15 m.' only (no DB label points to the landing top), while ชั้น 1's landing top is 'DB 12 mm. @ 0.05 m.' — recorded as printed, flagged landing_top_label_RB9_only.

Printed arithmetic that does not close, recorded as printed and flagged on the element: ST1 (ช่วงบน) ชั้น 1 rise '7@0.175 =1.235' (7 x 0.175 = 1.225); ST1 (ช่วงล่าง) ชั้น 2 run '12 @ 0.25 =2.25' (12 x 0.25 = 3.00; 9 x 0.25 = 2.25 as on the upper flight). Floor-to-floor rises close: ชั้น 1 = 2.275 + 1.235 = 3.51 printed (1.225 computed -> 3.50), ชั้น 2 = 1.75 + 1.75 = 3.50.

Step detail (แบบขยายเสริมเหล็กขั้นบันได): RB 9 mm. (ทุกมุม), RB 9 mm. @ 0.20 m. (ทุกขั้น), plus a 0.025 dimension at the riser (unlabelled — step cover or nosing offset; kept only as printed text, no field invented) — applies to every ST1 flight; recorded as a step bar layer on each ST1 entry.

Supports printed on the views: ST1 floor-1 flights end on B4A (landing end and the foot of the lower flight) and B4 (top of the upper flight); ST1 floor-2 flights end on B4 at both ends; ST2 (entrance steps below row E) sits on G4 / G5.

Type mismatch kept on purpose: the slab plans (หน้า17/18 _etc_plan_slab) record ST1/ST2 as element_type slab (the stair panel marks), while this detail sheet draws them as stairs (treads, risers, waist) — typed stair here, joined by element_id. The finished plan files were not edited.
